newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish June trade surplus FIM 5.82 billion -NCB.
newsitem.headline: Finnish June trade surplus FIM 5.82 billion -NCB.

text.p: Finland's trade surplus rose to 5.82 billion markka in June from 4.59 billion in May, the National Customs Board (NCB) said in a statement on Thursday.
The value of exports fell seven percent year-on-year in June while the value of imports fell four percent, NCB said.
The Bank of Finland earlier estimated the June trade surplus at 7.8 billion markka with exports estimated at 17.6 billion and imports at 9.8 billion.
The NCB's official monthly trade statistics are lagging behind due to changes in customs procedures when Finland joined the European Union at the start of 1995.
